telemetry.process_swap_policy: Each new serving process must be in a cgroup with memory.swap.max=0; both process VmSwap and cgroup memory.swap.current must stay zero. Missing protection or nonzero swap sends SIGINT and halts the campaign. OS swap stays enabled.
